The atom checklist states that the DAPO+Self-reflection bar in Physics reaches *close to* 61%, not exactly 61.0%.
The description does not explicitly state that three bars have diagonal stripes, as mentioned in the atom checklist.
The description mentions the axis range (50 to 62) and tick intervals (2 units) but does not explicitly state that the scale type is linear, as specified in the atom checklist.
The reference description does not mention black outlines, and the image does not clearly show black outlines for all bars. This detail is unnecessary and potentially misleading.
